heading: Choose Your Reflection
intro: Three standalone reflections. Start wherever your curiosity leads—each ends with your personal insights and an option to book a session.

cards.title: What Fuels Your Drive
cards.description: Notice what sparks your momentum right now—and where a hidden pattern may be getting in the way.

cards.title: Patterns Across Your Life
cards.description: Trace how your energy, daily actions, and real outcomes connect across the areas of life you care about.

cards.title: Inside the Nine Functions
cards.description: Look beneath day-to-day execution to see how your company's nine core functions connect as one system.
